set.details: Family staycation in October or November from AED 700 per night for 2 adults and 2 children up to 12, with dining included and a balcony suite upgrade subject to availability. Sunday to Thursday only.

set.description: 60-minute sightseeing boat tour along the Abu Dhabi Corniche, past Emirates Palace and around Lulu Island.
Esports and gaming hub at Al Qana with gaming PCs, consoles, VR experiences and racing simulators.
Observation Deck at 300 on the 74th floor of Etihad Towers, with views over the Corniche and the Gulf, coffee and afternoon tea.
Waterfront souk on the Khor Al Maqta canals with oud, perfume and fashion shops, cafés and restaurants, and abra rides.
Souvenirs, perfumes, dates and jewellery in the visitor centre beside the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque.
